name: Causal Organism Unsigned (Full Descendant Control)
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when The drug affects the causal organism without a direction requirement The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.; The organism is asserted to cause the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.
hypothesis: Decreasing a disease-causing organism is compatible with anti-infective therapy, unlike unsigned association.

nodes.role: Organism asserted to cause the disease
nodes.explanation: Organism asserted to cause the disease.

edges.subject: chemical
edges.explanation: The drug affects the causal organism without a direction requirement The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.

edges.subject: organism
edges.explanation: The organism is asserted to cause the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.

mechanism.rationale: Decreasing a disease-causing organism is compatible with anti-infective therapy, unlike unsigned association. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[organism_effect:{{relationship_types:organism_effect}}]->(organism:OrganismTaxon) WHERE organism_effect.predicate IN {{predicates:organism_effect}} MATCH (organism:OrganismTaxon)-[infection:{{relationship_types:infection}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE infection.predicate IN {{predicates:infection}} RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT organism) AS support_count

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Source assertions lack dose, exposure, clinical context, and experimental causal validation.
The full affects closure includes ameliorates_condition and is classified as treatment-using even if no such edge satisfies the other constraints in this graph.
